name: diag_test_priority_pending_after_pilot_01
command:
import fcntl,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from src.tools.gpu_shared_claim import SharedQueue
r=Path.cwd().resolve()
p=r/'configs/shared_test_priority_active_01.json'
pb=p.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(pb).hexdigest()=='a265edb569fc005af2abd4db28cfdcbdd3983cd0ef6af015365bd37a740dff2a'
plan=json.loads(pb)
root=Path('/scratch/e1583364/cvpr2027/shared_gpu_queue/test_priority_01')
with (root/'queue.lock').open('r') as stream:
 fcntl.flock(stream,fcntl.LOCK_SH)
 state_bytes=(root/'state.json').read_bytes()
 state=json.loads(state_bytes)
 binding=json.loads((root/'plan_reference.json').read_text())
 assert binding['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(pb).hexdigest()
 pending=SharedQueue.available(SimpleNamespace(plan=plan),state)
 rows=[]
 for u in plan['units']:
  s=state['units'].get(u['unit_id'])
  row={'name':u['name'],'budget_group':u['budget_group'],'unit_id':u['unit_id'],'available':u in pending,'state':s}
  if s:
   for key in ('claim_reference','release_reference'):
    ref=s.get(key)
    if ref:
     path=Path(ref['file']); path=path if path.is_absolute() else r/path
     raw=path.read_bytes()
     assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==ref['sha256']
     d=json.loads(raw)
     if key=='claim_reference': row['claim']={k:d.get(k) for k in ('pbs_jobid','name','node','gpu_uuid','started_epoch')}
     else: row['release']={k:d.get(k) for k in ('cleanup_errors','child_exit_code','all_owned_processes_ended','ended_epoch')}
  rows.append(row)
old=r/'logs/pbs/gpu_pack_test_priority_full_single_01-20261110T035335Z-d6ed5c3d/payload.json'
ob=old.read_bytes(); payload=json.loads(ob)
print(json.dumps({'scope':'Metadata-only read-only original shared queue snapshot; no claim/submit/release; root FP315 retry qsub receipt still pending separately','plan':{'file':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(pb).hexdigest()},'state':{'file':str(root/'state.json'),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(state_bytes).hexdigest()},'queue_plan_binding':binding,'available_units':[{'name':u['name'],'unit_id':u['unit_id'],'budget_group':u['budget_group'],'timeout_seconds':u['timeout_seconds'],'command':u['command']} for u in pending],'all_unit_status':rows,'original_consumer_payload':{'file':str(old),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(ob).hexdigest()},'original_consumer':{k:payload.get(k) for k in ('name','task','budget_group','gpus','walltime_seconds','command','requested_host')}},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
